top_comments.author: @JordanJordi-d4d
top_comments.text: The 27B sibling is more interesting to me. Near-max performance on deployable hardware means teams can iterate on agent design instead of just chasing leaderboard scores.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: That size is the sweet spot — strong enough to be useful, but light enough to actually run where people work instead of just in massive data centers. It shifts the focus from chasing numbers to shipping real products and experimenting with how agents behave. What would you build first if you didn’t have to worry about compute limits?
